硝环磺酮.note: Hand-authored: this string is named in the patent and the gold carries no English for it. Surfaces as: the identifier of a gold compound record; a Chinese term left inside the English of a translated source line. A TRANSLITERATION AND AN ADMISSION, NOT AN IDENTIFICATION. [0002] names two comparator herbicides whose activity tembotrione exceeds: 硝环磺酮 and 甲基磺草酮. The second is a standard Chinese common name for mesotrione, CAS 104206-82-8, whose other standard name is 硝磺草酮. The first names nothing: it returns no compound in any Chinese agrochemical source, while the two real names it sits between run in opposite directions, 硝磺草酮 for mesotrione and 环磺酮 for tembotrione itself. The Chinese trade literature this paragraph paraphrases states the comparison as '环磺酮是由拜耳公司2007年研制的三酮类玉米田除草剂新品种，其活性高于硝磺草酮', naming mesotrione alone, so the likeliest reading is a garbled 硝磺草酮 that has picked up a 环 from the 环磺酮 around it. Likeliest is not settled. That reading has the sentence name mesotrione twice, and reading it as tembotrione has the patent compare its target with its target, and the document decides neither. Pass V verified the four characters individually at 6x and they are as printed, so this is not a transcription artifact; compounds.json records it resolved:false for the same reason and the enriched source leaves it untranslated too. The English above therefore transliterates the printed name in pinyin and says in English that it is unidentified. That puts the string on a screen in English, which the reading team requires, without naming a molecule the evidence does not support, and it substitutes into [0002] as a sentence that still reads correctly. Confidence in the pinyin: high. Confidence in any molecular identity: none is offered, and the gold's resolved:false stands untouched. Sources consulted 2026-08-27: zh.wikipedia.org/wiki/硝磺草酮 for the mesotrione synonymy; the 环磺酮 product reviews at jsppa.com.cn and enongzi.com for the comparator sentence, none of which contains the string 硝环磺酮.
